title: Estimates Desk Ruling: Booking History and the Outpatient Surgery Initial Deposit
content:
Ruling of the Good Faith & Price Estimates desk on the initial deposit of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking whose estimate has been reissued.

**Ruling.** The versions furnished are counted as the versions of the estimate that carry a Riverbend facility line for the principal service code. Three or more such versions add ten percentage points (10) to the booking's deposit percentage; exactly two add five percentage points (5); one, or none recorded, adds none. The points are added to the booking's deposit percentage before that percentage is applied.

| Versions carrying a Riverbend facility line for the principal service code | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10 |
| exactly 2 | 5 |
| 1 | none |
| none recorded | none |

## Applying the count (hypothetical estimates)

- An estimate at version 3 whose versions 1, 2 and 3 each list the Riverbend facility line for the principal code: three versions, 10 points.
- An estimate at version 2 whose version 2 alone lists that facility line: one version counted, no points.
- Lines of other codes, professional lines and co-provider lines do not count toward the versions.
